Natural Oil Mix

How to use:
Hot Oil Treatment: wash your hair with shampoo, take 30 ml of Penduline oil and warm it for 3-5 minutes in water bath, massage the oil into scalp using fingertips, working your way from roots to ends, Heat a towel with clothes dryer, wrap your hair with the hot towel and allow it to sit for 20 minutes, wash and rinse hair thoroughly and enjoy the easy and wonderful styling, you can do that twice monthly.
It is recommended to continue using Penduline oil for 3 months to have your hair more thick, silky and tall.
